Company model

Set the direction. Let the company move. Keep control.

Orchistra connects leadership intent to goals, recurring operations, exceptions, human judgement, agent execution, and evidence, so the company can move without losing accountability.

01
Direction

Set the direction once.

The company North Star, mandate, priorities, constraints, and appetite for action begin with accountable people.

02
Strategy and goals

Turn ambition into measurable priorities.

Strategy and goals describe what matters now, who owns the outcome, and which evidence will show progress.

03
Programmes, projects and processes

Give the company a clear way to deliver.

Change work, recurring obligations, responsibilities, skills, and system relationships are made explicit.

04
Runs and work orders

Move the right work to the right worker.

Scheduled runs, tasks, exceptions, incidents, and remediation reach the people and agents responsible for moving them.

05
Human and agent execution

Let people and agents act with confidence.

Agents, routines, tools, and people act only within the identity, approval, target, and timing boundaries that apply.

06
Decisions and evidence

Keep control at the moments that matter.

Approvals, receipts, outcomes, sources, and human decisions remain available when the company needs to explain what happened.

07
Learning

Improve the company every time it runs.

Patterns become guidance, stronger processes, better controls, and clearer decisions without silently changing authority.

Two ways to begin

Start with one operating problem. Grow into the whole company.

Use Orchistra to direct a highly agentic company from a small leadership team, or introduce agents into an established organisation without weakening human responsibility.

Principal-led

Direct an agentic company without becoming its bottleneck.

One or two principals set direction, approve the choices that matter, and oversee agents, routines, and automations without manually relaying every step.

Organisation-integrated

Add AI agents to the business without losing control.

Boards, senior management, teams, and agents work through shared goals, authority, processes, and evidence while established responsibilities remain clear.

Human control surface

Know what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs you.

Direction, goals, processes, requests, work orders, receipts, and decisions stay attached to one operating picture. Leaders get the context to decide without becoming the manual relay for every agent.

Company outcomes

Everything leadership needs to turn AI into company performance.

Connect direction, responsibility, work, authority, evidence, and improvement so useful AI becomes part of how the company performs, not another experiment leaders have to chase.

01

Keep every team moving in the same direction

Connect the North Star, strategy, priorities, owners, and measurable outcomes to the work that should move them forward.

02

Make recurring work run with less chasing

Define what must happen, when it is due, who is responsible, and which evidence or approval completes it.

03

Turn strategy into visible, governed delivery

Connect programmes, projects, processes, tasks, owners, agents, and acceptance criteria in one operating picture.

04

Bring leaders in only when judgement matters

Route blockers, choices, and material approvals to the right person while routine work keeps moving within its boundaries.

05

Know what happened without reconstructing it

Keep messages, receipts, attachments, outcomes, and audit-visible decisions searchable by the people and agents allowed to see them.

06

Make every operating cycle smarter than the last

Turn repeated questions, outcomes, and patterns into better guidance, stronger processes, and clearer future decisions.

Works with the company you already have

Keep the systems you trust. Add the operating layer they do not provide.

Finance, CRM, HR, banking, customer, and specialist systems each know part of the company. Orchistra connects direction, responsibility, cross-system work, exceptions, approvals, and evidence across them.

  • Finance
  • CRM
  • HR
  • Banking
  • Customer systems
  • Specialist tools

Current progress

Built on working foundations. Expanding toward the whole company.

Orchistra already brings company direction, governed work, human attention, and evidence into one operating picture. The product is now extending those foundations into broader, repeatable company execution.

Working now

A working operating core

Strategy, goals, processes, conversations, human attention, work orders, permissions, evidence, search, and Mac, Web, CLI, and MCP access already form the core product.

Being proven

From governed work to governed execution

Scheduled process runs, execution connectors, approval-bound actions, receipts, and company-wide operating views are moving through controlled proof and release gates.

Next

A repeatable operating system for other companies

The next layer is wider system integration, sharper board and executive views, and repeatable deployment patterns for other organisations.

Each environment enables only the capabilities, integrations, and authority its accountable people approve.
